intent: Adaptive relative measurement importance and point-in-time valuation-scenario gating; NOT probabilities, fair-value calibration or an autonomous trading rule.

pre_prospectus.description: Confidential IPO filing or 2027 talk but no publicly verified S-1 pricing/financial disclosure

prospectus_public.description: Public audited S-1 / prospectus available with GAAP results and cap table

bookbuilding.description: Official SEC filing plus dated proposed offering price range and share classes

post_listing.description: Actual IPO/listing completed; >=20 completed public sessions needed for traversal

revenue_quality.measurement: recognized GAAP revenue by channel, gross vs net, ARR/annualized distinct; B2B revenue share
falsifiers: previously quoted run rate not reconciled to audited quarterly sales

growth_durability.measurement: quarterly sequential and YoY growth by enterprise/API/consumer, net retention, contracted/collected bookings
falsifiers: enterprise growth fails to translate to cash

unit_economics.measurement: net monetization per delivered workload, inference gross profit, training amortization, token costs, gross margin after infrastructure, SBC
falsifiers: declining net dollar output per compute dollar
non-GAAP excludes material compensation or training costs

capital_funding.measurement: unrestricted cash, operating/FCF burn, committed-vs-funded new capital, minimum compute obligations, financing rates, maturity, net dilution
falsifiers: contracted lease obligations exceed deployable capacity

competitive_position.measurement: enterprise seat/workload share, churn, pricing pressure, model quality by use case, distribution/channel concentration
falsifiers: net retention undercuts gross sales growth
open-weight alternatives materially undercut inference pricing

governance_dilution.measurement: Foundation control, preferred/common IPO conversions, warrants, equity issuance, employee SBC, listing lockups, voting concentration
falsifiers: unexpected conversion preference reduces common per-share value
new financing dilutes prior holder more than modeled

market_price_discovery.measurement: completed priced rounds, verified secondary trades, IPO offering range/books, public comparable forward EV/revenue on aligned basis, perps only separately
falsifiers: perp marks deviate materially from settled cash transaction
stale/illiquid proxy shown as market quote

compute_delivery.measurement: signed/funded/energized GPU capacity, realized utilization and inference throughput, supplier credit stress, collateral and delivery SLAs
falsifiers: unfunded commitments treated as productive assets

neutral.description: No evidence of special funding or pricing regime

credit_stress.description: Widening provider spreads/refinancing stress supported by dated security data; no claim that distress caused OpenAI repricing

competition_price_war.description: Independent evidence of broad per-token price compression

methodology.evidence_coverage: C=SUM(weight_i/100 × reliability_i) where reliability_i in [0,1] must come from evidence rubric, not assertion
methodology.conditional_factor_score: For independently assigned, sourced factor ratings 0..100 ONLY: score_known=SUM(weight_i × reliability_i × rating_i)/SUM(weight_i × reliability_i) across rated factors. Missing/unrated factors are not zero or 50.
methodology.bounds: quality_score_lower=SUM(weight_i × reliability_i × rating_i)/100; upper=lower + SUM(weight_i × (1-reliability_i))/1 on a 0..100 basis (ratings required for positive reliability). Report coverage alongside BOTH and never call bounds valuation confidence intervals.
methodology.no_probability: No predictive IPO probability, chance of IPO price or calibrated returns without point-in-time walk-forward testing.
methodology.maturity: Never automatically promote IPO stage from elapsed time; require externally verified, available-on-date proof.
methodology.no_leakage: Only observations available_on <= as_of_date and last valid/revised evidence permitted. Day precision cannot establish intraday availability.
methodology.missing_metric: Do not hide missing denominators via redistributed weights. Publish unknown/not_ready and factor importance separately from observed quality.
gating: no published IPO target or equity fair value without audited normalized revenue, EV-to-equity bridge, funding schedule and fully diluted share rights
no net SFTBY NAV without B09 reconciled embedded SVF2 mark and fund waterfall
methodology.issuer_ev_proxy: EV_proxy_2027_USD_b = normalized_forward_revenue_2027_USD_b × explicit_EV_to_revenue_multiple_scenario; Equity_proxy=EV_proxy + unrestricted_excess_cash - debt - other_senior_equity_claims; explicit inputs only
methodology.financing: Additional financing proceeds enter cash AND new share count; do not subtract future cash calls from equity while also deducting corresponding forecast FCF in DCF. A multiple scenario and a full FCFF DCF are alternative methods, not quantities to add.
methodology.ipo_price: offering_per_share = pre_or_post_money_equity_value_USD / appropriately defined fully diluted common-equivalent shares; unknown until filed security class, range and new shares. IPO aftermarket prices are not predictable from pre-IPO perp.
methodology.dcf_future: B04-owned FCFF DCF: EV=sum_t FCFF_t/(1+WACC)^t + TV/(1+WACC)^N; negative cash flow requires financing analysis and dilution; model and snapshot IDs mandatory.

next_review_triggers: 2026 Q4 revenue and cash burn disclosed
new compute-delivery contract or financing stress
Anthropic actual IPO completed and audited financials released
new share conversion or dilution change
